basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Noe Valley, this beautifully updated Marina-style home offers luxurious living on two levels. The striking entry foyer with built-in library leads to a sophisticated main floor featuring a spacious, full width living room with fireplace and custom cabinetry.Formal dining room with beveled glass French doors opening to a view balcony, and the bright, open renovated chef's kitchen boasts quartz counters and stainless appliances. Two generously sized bedrooms, a stylish full bath, and direct access to a large, sun-drenched deck with downtown views complete this level. The lower floor highlights a family/media room and a sumptuous primary suite with a large walk-in closet and remodeled en-suite bath with heated floors and large walk-in shower. This level offers laundry and direct access to the extra-deep, landscaped garden which provides a serene oasis retreat with a flagstone patio and mature trees. 1 car garage parking with storage. Perfectly situated just above Sanchez's Slow Street'' and close to beloved neighborhood parks, this home is within reach of top-rated schools including Alvarado Elementary and St. Paul's. Enjoy the vibrant shops, cafes, and restaurants along 24th, Church, and Valencia Streets, with easy access to tech shuttles, MUNI, and freeways
